text: Write a fight scene: Spyder Math versus ProofMotion, one continuous duel.
Scripted six beats: standoff, chasm, ramp, stair, spiral, and the dab.

operations.title: The Challenger Takes Form
operations.narration: Spyder Math stands his ground as ProofMotion gathers itself out of raw geometry — vertices, chords, and intent. Neither moves first.

operations.title: Round One: The Chasm
operations.bridge: so it opens with a gap he cannot walk
operations.narration: ProofMotion strings a chasm on a hanging cable. Spyder Math answers with a pendulum: grab, swing, release, catch. The rope does the mathematics; he just holds on.

operations.title: Round Two: The Tilted Ground
operations.bridge: denied the gap, it tilts the ground instead
operations.narration: The floor itself betrays him, curling into a smooth cubic ramp. He leans into the slope and runs it, feet tracing the curve exactly — a derivative kept underfoot.

operations.title: Round Three: The Quantized Stair
operations.bridge: if he can run a curve, it will take the curve away
operations.narration: ProofMotion shatters the slope into discrete steps. Continuous is forbidden now — so Spyder Math goes discrete too, hopping parabola after parabola, landing every tread.

operations.title: Final Round: The Golden Coil
operations.bridge: its last form is the oldest one
operations.narration: Its final form: the golden spiral, coiled to swallow him toward the center. He does not resist the mathematics. He rides it, arc by shrinking arc.

operations.title: Geometry Yields
operations.bridge: out of forms, out of moves
operations.narration: And ProofMotion, out of forms, dissolves back into theorems. Spyder Math celebrates the only way a mathematician should.
